dataset: MultiNLI 1.0 (Williams, Nangia and Bowman, 2018), OANC-derived, released for research -- the raw train/dev_matched/dev_mismatched jsonl splits read straight from multinli_1.0.zip, each row carrying an annotator_labels list and a single gold_label
note: For each MultiNLI row the gold is gold_label and the annotators are annotator_labels. strict majority = a label held by more than half the annotators. A labeled row (gold in entailment/neutral/contradiction) is checked for gold == strict majority and for having a majority at all; a '-' row is checked for having no majority. n_gold_mismatch_majority, n_labeled_without_majority and n_no_consensus_with_majority should all be 0 if the documented derivation and filter rules hold. MultiNLI validated only its dev and test sets, so train is expected to be entirely single-annotator with no '-' rows (hist {1: 392702}), unlike SNLI's train, whose file holds a validated subset. The per-split no_consensus counts are the first published row-by-row figures for this release; they are reported, not pre-bet on an exact number. n_multi counts rows with >= 2 annotators and n_unanimous_multi those whose annotators all agree.
